{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-6vnnqh",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure loss at P-R (receiving header) while upstream P-U remained stable indicates the interruption occurred in the distribution path between U and R, consistent with n-6vnnqh suggesting an upstream or distribution system issue rather than equipment failure at RHOB.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the interruption had occurred at RHOB equipment, P-U would likely have shown a corresponding drop or flow reduction.",
      "competingExplanation": "A localized valve failure downstream of U but upstream of R could also explain stable P-U and dropping P-R; this is consistent with n-6vnnqh's hypothesis about distribution system issues.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms which specific segment between the gallery (U) and RHOB header (R) experienced the loss, nor does evidence identify a valve state change."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-6vnnqh",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The transient nature of the pressure loss (restored by 10:07 AM) suggests a temporary distribution anomaly rather than permanent equipment failure, supporting n-6vnnqh's hypothesis that the issue originated upstream or in the distribution system.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the failure were at RHOB equipment, pressure would likely not have recovered without maintenance intervention.",
      "competingExplanation": "A temporary blockage or valve misposition in the distribution line could also cause transient loss; this aligns with n-6vnnqh's upstream/distribution hypothesis.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record identifies a specific valve state change, routing modification, or physical obstruction that caused the transient event."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-aag550",
      "toKey": "n-1sd8vsk",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure extract (IA-P01) provides only sampled values and excludes data from all locations or valve states, meaning it cannot confirm whether the event was isolated to RHOB or occurred elsewhere in the distribution system.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the extract included continuous data from all points, it could confirm whether other downstream locations experienced simultaneous pressure loss.",
      "competingExplanation": "The sampled nature of IA-P01 is a known limitation; absence of evidence for other points does not prove they were unaffected.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms the status (pressure or alarm) at North gallery or any other downstream point during the event window."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-aag550",
      "toKey": "n-177jnpq",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The point register (IA-P02) maps signals but does not establish the state of any distribution valve, meaning it cannot confirm whether a specific valve was open/closed or mispositioned during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the point register included valve-state data, it could confirm whether a specific distribution valve was in an unexpected position.",
      "competingExplanation": "Valve states may be inferred from pressure trends but are not directly recorded; absence of explicit state record leaves this as unknown.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms the physical configuration or operational status of any distribution valves during the event."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time, indicating the work boundary had not been formally released. This condition may have contributed to an unrecorded valve state or routing change occurring during preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the maintenance acceptance had been signed, a formal boundary release would likely have prevented unauthorized valve manipulation.",
      "competingExplanation": "An unrecorded change could occur even with proper authorization if procedures are not followed; absence of signature does not prove an error occurred.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether any field operations or valve manipulations were performed without formal boundary release during the event window."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work folder WO-527-E was blank at issue time, suggesting incomplete documentation of the maintenance scope. This may have contributed to an unrecorded valve state or routing change occurring during preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the work folder had been properly completed, it would likely have documented any valve manipulations or routing changes.",
      "competingExplanation": "A blank form field records no value; absence of documentation does not prove an error occurred but indicates a gap in record-keeping.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether the work folder was completed before or after the event, nor what specific tasks were performed."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-xuyu0f",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The daily work briefing contained no valve-by-valve content, meaning operators may not have been aware of specific configuration changes or required procedures. This could contribute to an unrecorded hazard scenario.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the briefing had included valve-by-valve content, operators would likely have been aware of any configuration changes or required procedures.",
      "competingExplanation": "Briefing absence does not prove an error occurred but indicates a gap in communication; other sources (e.g., drawings) may have provided necessary information.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether crew received recent change briefing or saw specific configuration drawing used during the event window."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1hmiwux",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Crew U-A/U-B held current operating qualifications at shift start, but this does not guarantee awareness of specific configuration changes or procedures. Qualifications alone do not prevent unrecorded valve state errors.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If crew had received specific change briefing, they would likely have been aware of any configuration changes or required procedures.",
      "competingExplanation": "Qualifications do not guarantee awareness; absence of recent change briefing leaves this as a potential contributing factor.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether crew received recent change briefing or saw specific configuration drawing used during the event window."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lq9li6",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The area directory (IA-D01) does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time, meaning it cannot confirm whether a specific valve was in an unexpected position during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the area directory included valve-state data, it could confirm whether a specific distribution valve was in an unexpected position.",
      "competingExplanation": "Directory limitations are known; absence of explicit state record leaves this as unknown but does not prove no error occurred.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms the physical configuration or operational status of any distribution valves during the event."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1cs3s92",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Desk entries do not log every field operation or identify the point of interruption, meaning they cannot confirm whether a specific valve was manipulated without authorization.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If desk entries logged every field operation, they could confirm whether a specific valve was manipulated without authorization.",
      "competingExplanation": "Desk entry limitations are known; absence of explicit record leaves this as unknown but does not prove no error occurred.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms the physical configuration or operational status of any distribution valves during the event."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rww984",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment or response steps is present, meaning it cannot confirm whether operators were aware of potential hazards during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If documentation confirmed understanding, it could confirm whether operators were aware of potential hazards during the event.",
      "competingExplanation": "Absence of confirmation does not prove lack of awareness but indicates a gap in communication or procedure adherence.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether crew received recent change briefing or saw specific configuration drawing used during the event window."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1ubp9xd",
      "toKey": "n-aag550",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB requested Utilities attendance at 10:00; work paused by 10:02, indicating a communication breakdown between RHOB and Utilities that may have contributed to delayed response or unrecorded valve state errors.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If communication had been effective, Utilities might have responded more quickly or prevented the event.",
      "competingExplanation": "Communication breakdown is a known issue; absence of explicit record leaves this as unknown but does not prove no error occurred.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether crew received recent change briefing or saw specific configuration drawing used during the event window."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The incident involved a transient instrument-air pressure loss at RHOB receiving header H-R while upstream P-U remained stable. Evidence supports that the interruption occurred in the distribution system between U and R, likely due to an unrecorded valve state change or routing modification during maintenance preparation. Contributing factors include incomplete work documentation (blank folder), lack of valve-by-valve briefing content, absence of signed acceptance signature, and communication gaps between RHOB and Utilities.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1",
      "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1",
      "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1",
      "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Specific valve state or routing change that caused the pressure loss",
      "Whether any field operations were performed without formal boundary release",
      "Status of other downstream points during the event window"
    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "Upstream source failure (ruled out by stable P-U)",
      "RHOB equipment failure (ruled out by transient nature and recovery)"
    ],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },"evidenceRequests":[

]
}
